name: Seven alarms
summary: A 15-second game: the friend who sets seven alarms is asleep and his clocks ring in a pattern the whole chat shares; snooze each one before he wakes, and everyone's best run sits on the board.
useWhen: a running joke about someone's alarms or oversleeping: 'calvin has seven alarms'
a quick two-minute game the chat can compete on, with a shared board
dontUseWhen: setting a real reminder or alarm (use reminder)
a trivia or word game (use trivia-night)
teasing that lands on one person's real problem
